name: PoisonCharges v1.2.1 Release (Classic 1.14.4)
body:
CHANGELOG:

v1.2.1 (23.08.2023)

- Renamed functions to match recent Container API changes.

v1.2 (16.11.2019)

- Updated for WoW Classic.

v1.1 (18.08.2019)

- Added configuration menu.
- Added minimap button.
- Added buttons to apply poisons with one click.

v1.0 (19.07.2015)

- Added track of remaining time and remaining amount of charges of applied poisons.
- Added slash commands.
